'''Ordtech''' was a weapons-developing company that built [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
